text: NBS Beijing survey team on Aug 10 said July Beijing CPI rose 0.2% MoM (June -0.4%) and rose 0.2% YoY, a 0.5 ppt slowdown from June. Food prices fell 0.6% MoM, a 0.6 ppt narrower decline than last month. By item: seasonal fruit supply pushed fresh fruit down 4.0%; eggs fell 1.7% o
text_zh: 国家统计局北京调查总队8月10日表示，7月北京CPI环比上涨0.2%（6月为-0.4%），同比上涨0.2%，较6月涨幅回落0.5个百分点。食品价格环比下降0.6%，降幅较上月收窄0.6个百分点。分项看：季节性水果供应使鲜果价格下降4.0%；鸡蛋价格下降1.7%
